metadata.description: Individually installable HTML artifact skills with bundled offline templates.

plugins.name: animation-playground
plugins.description: Build an HTML animation prototype with tunable timing, easing, and transition parameters plus export. Use when the user wants to compare or fine-tune motion interactively before coding it into a product.

plugins.name: annotated-code-review
plugins.description: Render an evidence-backed code review as an HTML diff with line-anchored findings and severity labels. Use when the user specifically wants an annotated HTML PR review or interactive diff review artifact.

plugins.name: annotation-workbench
plugins.description: Build an HTML interface for source-anchored annotations on documents, transcripts, or diffs with structured export. Use when the user wants to label or comment on a specific source without modifying it.

plugins.name: artifact-inventory
plugins.description: Catalog and categorize an authorized collection of generated artifacts in a searchable HTML inventory. Use when the user wants to discover recurring artifact types, inspect coverage, or browse existing HTML outputs.

plugins.name: code-path-explainer
plugins.description: Trace a concrete behavior through source code and produce an annotated HTML execution-path explainer. Use when the user wants to understand how a specific code path works, with real snippets and source-linked flow diagrams.

plugins.name: component-gallery
plugins.description: Create a browsable HTML catalog of component variants and states tied to their source definitions. Use when the user wants a visual component library, state matrix, or design-system coverage gallery.

plugins.name: component-tuner
plugins.description: Build an offline HTML playground for tuning a component's appearance and behavior with parameter export. Use when the user wants sliders, toggles, or selectors to adjust a component before implementation.

plugins.name: constrained-config-editor
plugins.description: Build an HTML form for editing structured configuration with schema validation, dependency checks, and changed-value export. Use when the user wants a safe visual editor for feature flags or JSON/YAML configuration.

plugins.name: dataset-curator
plugins.description: Build an offline HTML interface for approving, rejecting, tagging, and selecting dataset examples with auditable export. Use when the user wants to curate a concrete dataset through a purpose-built review UI.

plugins.name: design-explorer
plugins.description: Create an HTML gallery of distinct visual directions for one feature. Use when the user wants side-by-side design alternatives, layout explorations, or a visual decision page rather than a single polished design.

plugins.name: design-token-preview
plugins.description: Create an HTML reference that renders real design tokens as color swatches, typography, spacing, and component examples. Use when the user wants to inspect or compare a design system visually rather than read raw token files.

plugins.name: feature-brief
plugins.description: Create a concise HTML overview of a feature's purpose, behavior, architecture, and limitations. Use when the user wants a source-backed feature summary for onboarding, handoff, or stakeholder understanding.

plugins.name: html-artifact
plugins.description: Create self-contained, accessible HTML artifacts for plans, code reviews, explainers, reports, prototypes, and purpose-built editing interfaces. Use when the user requests an HTML artifact or when a specialized skill explicitly delegates its presentation and export layer to this foundation.

plugins.name: implementation-explorer
plugins.description: Create an HTML comparison of implementation approaches grounded in the actual codebase. Use when the user wants alternative technical approaches, tradeoffs, or an HTML decision aid before choosing an implementation.

plugins.name: incident-report
plugins.description: Assemble incident evidence into a blameless HTML report with impact, timeline, contributing factors, and follow-up actions. Use when the user requests an HTML incident review or visual postmortem.

plugins.name: pr-walkthrough
plugins.description: Create a source-linked HTML companion explaining a pull request to reviewers. Use when the user wants an HTML PR overview, reviewer guide, or visual walkthrough of a change, rather than a defect review.

plugins.name: prioritization-board
plugins.description: Build an HTML board for reordering and bucketing tickets, test cases, or feedback with structured export. Use when the user wants to prioritize a concrete collection interactively without changing the source tracker.

plugins.name: prompt-template-lab
plugins.description: Create an HTML prompt or text-template editor with highlighted variables, live sample previews, and export. Use when the user wants to tune a prompt or template against concrete examples without live model calls.

plugins.name: research-synthesizer
plugins.description: Synthesize authorized documents, code, history, and web or connected-service evidence into a source-linked HTML research report. Use when the user wants a readable HTML synthesis across multiple sources.

plugins.name: technical-diagrammer
plugins.description: Produce accessible SVG technical diagrams embedded in a self-contained HTML artifact. Use when the user wants architecture, sequence, workflow, or state diagrams grounded in supplied evidence.

plugins.name: technical-explainer
plugins.description: Create an HTML learning artifact that teaches a technical concept through diagrams, worked examples, and gotchas. Use when the user wants an interactive explanation or HTML lesson, rather than a source-code trace alone.

plugins.name: visual-implementation-plan
plugins.description: Turn an agreed technical approach into an evidence-linked HTML implementation plan with interfaces, data flow, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Use when the user requests a visual plan or an HTML handoff for implementation.

plugins.name: visual-parameter-picker
plugins.description: Build a focused HTML picker for values difficult to express in prose, such as colors, easing curves, crop regions, cron schedules, or regexes. Use when the user wants domain-specific preview and exact-value export.

plugins.name: weekly-status-report
plugins.description: Create an evidence-linked HTML status report for an explicit reporting period. Use when the user wants a weekly HTML update synthesized from authorized issues, PRs, commits, documents, or supplied notes.
